# NorthStar Design System

> Design language and development kit for dense, dark, data-heavy enterprise consoles by Mikel Rosenthal: 53 components, 218 tokens, dark and light themes, framework-free HTML with ns- classes. v1.4.1, exported 2026-11-08.

The docs site renders with JavaScript. Agents should read the files below instead of the HTML routes.

## Agent files

- [Agent guide](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/agent/northstar.md): rules, floorplans, patterns, semantic tokens and every component with markup
- [Components](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/agent/components.json): the full catalog as JSON
- [Tokens](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/agent/tokens.json): every --ns- token with dark and light values
- [tokens.css](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/css/tokens.css): the token sheet to link
- [components.css](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/css/components.css): the component sheet to link

## Human pages

- [AI agent guide](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/#/getting-started/agent-guide)
- [Element reference](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/#/getting-started/element-reference): names and the aliases people use
- [Component status](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/#/getting-started/component-status): what is linked to Figma
- [Tokens](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/#/foundations/tokens)
- [Accessibility](https://mikelrosenthal.com/northstar/#/accessibility)
